`NumPyRandom` is a backend abstraction component that encapsulates random number generation utilities for the NumPy computational backend in `tslearn`. It sits within the library's backend dispatch system, providing a unified interface (`rand`, `randint`, `randn`) so that higher-level time-series algorithms can generate random numbers agnostically without hardcoding the underlying array library (e.g., NumPy vs. PyTorch).
